_readme: HOW TO ADD A PRODUCT — read this first. 1) Copy any object inside 'products' below, from the opening { to the closing }. 2) Paste it just before the closing ] of the products array, add a comma after the previous product's }. 3) Change 'id' to the next number (e.g. '009'). 4) Change 'slug' to a short lowercase-with-dashes version of the name — this becomes the shareable URL: product.html?slug=your-slug. 5) Set 'price' (normal price) and 'salePrice' (leave equal to price, or null, if there is no discount). 6) Set 'featured': true to show it in the homepage Featured section. Set 'bestSeller': true to show a Best Seller badge. Set 'newProduct': true to show a New badge. 7) 'image' and 'gallery' point to files inside assets/images/ — upload a JPG or PNG with that exact file name from your phone, or keep the placeholder path for now. 8) 'downloadUrl' and 'checkoutUrl' are placeholders until a real payment backend is connected — see README.md. 9) Save the file. That's it — every page on the site (home, store, categories, bundles, product page, sitemap-eligible search) reads from this one file automatically. 10) Don't forget to add the new URL to sitemap.xml the same way (copy a <url> block and edit it).
